paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy (in percentage) of three different Llama3 base language models—Llama3-1B, Llama3-3B, and Llama3-8B—as a function of the compression factor (c), which ranges from 1 to 5 on a linear scale along the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", spans from 25% to 75% with major gridlines every 10 percentage points and minor gridlines every 5 percentage points, also on a linear scale. Each model is represented by a distinct colored line with circular markers: Llama3-1B (brown), Llama3-3B (purple), and Llama3-8B (blue). All three lines show a consistent downward trend as the compression factor increases, indicating a decline in accuracy with higher compression. At a compression factor of 1, the accuracies are approximately 47% for Llama3-1B, 62% for Llama3-3B, and 71% for Llama3-8B. At a compression factor of 5, the accuracies drop to approximately 27% for Llama3-1B, 38% for Llama3-3B, and 43% for Llama3-8B. The lines remain well-separated throughout, with Llama3-8B consistently achieving the highest accuracy and Llama3-1B the lowest at each compression level.
